L608: The notion of Hodge Image$d$-equivalence will play a crucial role in our proof of Lefschetz-type results. In fact, our strategy for proving Theorem 1.1.1 for Image$G = \mu _p$ is to reduce to the analogous statement for Hodge cohomology, which follows from the results of [Reference Antieau, Bhatt and Mathew ABM21] on Hodge Image$d$-equivalences.
L609: To proceed, it is important to have a good supply of interesting Hodge Image$d$-equivalences, and we begin by providing some examples. In the next section, we will provide more examples after reviewing the related notion of Kodaira pairs from [Reference Antieau, Bhatt and Mathew ABM21].
L617: Proof. The first claim is [Reference Antieau, Bhatt and Mathew ABM21, Proposition 5.3], and the second follows from [Reference Antieau, Bhatt and Mathew ABM21, Ex. 5.6] and [Reference Antieau, Bhatt and Mathew ABM21, Proposition 5.7]. Using [Reference Deligne and Illusie DI87, Corollary 2.8], the proof of the third claim is very similar to that of [Reference Antieau, Bhatt and Mathew ABM21, Proposition 5.7], but we spell out the details at the referee's request.
